draftA:
Claim decision: Shipment SHP-9031 (18 kg glassware, damaged on arrival)

Customer refund: 1,200
Under customer policy R-4, damage on arrival is refunded at the full invoice value, which is 1,200.

Carrier claim: 450
Carrier contract C-7 limits liability to 25 per kg unless declared value cover was bought. SHP-9031 had no declared value cover, so the limit applies: 18 kg x 25 = 450. R-4 says to recover what the contract allows, so we claim the full 450. The cap is below the 1,200 invoice value, so we cannot recover more.

Net cost to us: 750 (1,200 refunded minus 450 recovered).

Deadline: C-7 requires claims within 30 days of delivery. SHP-9031 was delivered on 2026-11-03, so the claim must be filed by 2026-12-03. File promptly. If that date has passed, the carrier recovery may be lost, but the customer refund still stands.

Evidence: Damage photos are on file. Attach them to the carrier claim.

Notes: The sources give no currency, so amounts are shown in the invoice's units. For future high-value fragile shipments, consider buying declared value cover to avoid this kind of shortfall.

Actions:
1. Refund the customer 1,200.
2. File a 450 claim with the carrier under C-7, with photos, by 2026-12-03.
3. Record a 750 net loss on SHP-9031.
